_comment: Ratchet floor for checks.py::check_suite_baseline. R31: a baseline is a TUPLE, not a scalar - a bare integer pins a number whose meaning depends on which interpreter produced it. The top-level passed/failed/skipped remain the GATE numbers and are kept DELIBERATELY for backward compatibility: harness/state/leg0_baselines.json's evidence_command and any other flat reader continue to work unchanged (Q2-F6). New readers should prefer the named halves below. Advance this file ONLY in a human-promoted commit; the ratchet reads it at merge-base(master, HEAD), never the worktree, so a sprint cannot lower its own bar.

gate._what: What CI enforces. Commandment 7 compares against this.
gate.vendor_tree: INACTIVE - no cp314 wheels; resolves pip-installed pydantic/anthropic

shipping._what: What artists actually run. The ONLY number a release claim may cite. First measured 2026-07-26 - it had never been measured before, because the runner carried --ignore flags for exactly the files that fail to collect (Q2-F2).
shipping.vendor_tree: ACTIVE - _VENDOR_ABI_RISK False; the vendored wheels artists receive
shipping._ratchet: NOT yet a ratchet floor. This is a first measurement, not a green line. It becomes a floor once the 827-test gap is classified and the environment half is closed.
shipping._open: Q2-F4 claims the gap is ~60% ENVIRONMENT / ~33% test-harness / 0% shipping-code. That is VERIFIED-DERIVED and under attack. Do not cite the 0% clause as runtime-verified.
shipping._superseded_note: Bare shipping number, no deps supplied. Kept as the honest 'fresh install' figure - it is what an artist gets today. See shipping_with_deps for the measurable-environment figure.

_banned: --ignore in any measurement runner (R39). A measurement that excludes its own failures is not a measurement. Use --continue-on-collection-errors: it records the error and proceeds.

shipping_with_deps._what: The shipping interpreter WITH its missing dependencies supplied to a side directory. R47: this is a measurement instrument, not a fix - it does nothing for an artist installing fresh. A release claim citing this number MUST say the deps were supplied.
shipping_with_deps._delta_vs_bare: +728 passed, -53 failed, -759 errors. 88% of failures and 98% of errors were environment (R47).
shipping_with_deps._residual: 57 failures did NOT move when the environment did, so they are not environment. Sampled: RETINA frame evaluator reports verified=False with no image library present - product code degrading correctly, with a test that should SKIP on a missing optional dependency rather than fail.
